candidateEvidence.reason: Automated branch and pull-request validation is implementation evidence, not production-release reliability evidence.

qualificationRules: A qualified release must be deployed to the intended production environment.
The release must complete the documented observation window.
Every reliability target must be supported by archived evidence.
A pull request, local test or CI run alone is not a qualified production release.
The two qualifying releases must be consecutive and must not have an intervening failed release.
limitations: This ledger intentionally contains no fabricated production release evidence.
M7 technical implementation can be complete while the release-exit gate remains pending.
Legal, privacy, security and release approvals remain separate decisions.
